subclass.rites_and_paths.face_changer.de: Spy and impostor. With a spyglass you study players and humanoid mobs until you learn their face, then disguise yourself as them: with a mob's face its faction ignores you, and with a player's face others mistake you for them.
ability.rites_and_paths.spy_glass.name: Spy's Spyglass
ability.rites_and_paths.spy_glass.desc: Looking through a spyglass shows the target's health and, at higher subclass levels, its armor and effects; it is also marked and glows only for you for a few seconds. Looking at a player or at a villager, illager, witch, piglin or humanoid undead builds up study (it doesn't need to be continuous): when complete you learn their face. Mobs are learned by type and players one by one. A disguised target can't be studied.
ability.rites_and_paths.disguise.name: Disguise
ability.rites_and_paths.disguise.desc: Opens the list of learned faces and you put one on. With a mob's face, its whole faction ignores you. With a player's face, others see their skin, size and name, you disappear from the Tab list and death messages show their name. Your allies see you disguised but with your real name. Attacking doesn't break it, but it gives you away to the target and nearby members of its faction; mobs that were already chasing you know you are an impostor until they lose aggro. Water, rain, fire or entering stealth break the disguise and grant a brief escape (Speed and invisibility). Press again to take it off; the cooldown starts when the disguise ends. It is only visual: your hitbox and reach don't change.
msg.rites_and_paths.disguise.no_faces: You don't know any face yet: study someone with a spyglass.
msg.rites_and_paths.disguise.cannot: You can't put on a disguise while wet, burning or in stealth.
msg.rites_and_paths.disguise.broken.stea: Hiding in the shadows, you take off your disguise.
msg.rites_and_paths.spyglass.learned: You have learned the face of %s!
ui.rites_and_paths.disguise.title: Faces
ability.rites_and_paths.divine_smite.des: Every few melee hits, your weapon unleashes a holy smite that adds damage to the hit; twice as much against undead and Nether creatures.
ability.rites_and_paths.camouflage.name: Camouflage
ability.rites_and_paths.camouflage.desc: Crouch and stay still for a few seconds to become invisible to mobs and players until you move, stand up or shoot.
ability.rites_and_paths.sniper_mark.name: Aimed Mark
ability.rites_and_paths.sniper_mark.desc: Look at an enemy through a spyglass for a few seconds in a row to mark it (one at a time). It glows for you and your next shot that hits it deals much more damage.
ability.rites_and_paths.blood_bond.name: Blood Bond
ability.rites_and_paths.blood_bond.desc: Look at a nearby ally or enemy and press to bind yourself to them with a blood tether (one of each at most). Half of the damage your ally takes comes to you as true damage; your enemy also suffers part of all the damage you take, including the health you pay with Sacrifice. It breaks if you get too far apart; press while looking at a bound target (or at nothing) to break it.
ability.rites_and_paths.guardian_angel.d: While you pray for an ally, the first hit that would kill them is negated. Each ally has its own cooldown.
msg.rites_and_paths.blood_bond.no_target: There is no one to bind to.

msg.rites_and_paths.blood_bond.enemy: Bound to %s: they will suffer with you.
msg.rites_and_paths.guardian_angel.saved: A guardian angel has saved you!

druid.rites_and_paths.ability.claw_slash: A claw slash on the enemy you look at.
